Primary responsibilities encompass the asset management of complex Project Finance loans for renewable energy, thermal, midstream, and other asset classes as well as assisting with the underwriting, structuring, negotiating, and closing of these loans. Prepare high-quality underwriting packages in support of annual reviews, amendments, modifications, or restructures, describing the strengths, weaknesses, risks, and mitigating factors related to a transaction. Additionally, assist in the preparation of underwriting packages for proposed debt financings. Manage through project issues that may arise and provide value-added solutions, proactively identifying uncertainties and grey-area situations to take well-reasoned and well-mitigated risk. Articulate the Bank’s position to customers and advocate on behalf of Sponsors with Credit and management. Assist in managing third party professionals including attorneys, accountants, consultants, and engineers. Coordinate with internal parties to facilitate the underwriting, credit approval, and execution of portfolio management and new loan requests. Support the Project Management team in managing existing and closing new transactions in accordance with bank policies while furthering the Bank’s customer relationships. Review complex legal documents pertaining to structured credit arrangements as well as all necessary third-party reports to support financing requests; works with teammates and other associates to mitigate risks on behalf of USBIF. Participate in special projects, including the maintenance and revision of internal policies and procedures. Follow account opening procedures and internal suspicious activity referral requirements and processes. Familiarity with standard banking processes and procedures, including managing to credit policies and procedures and navigating credit approval processes. Excellent time management skills with the ability to effectively manage client timelines and needs. Ability to identify obstacles and manage expectations, both internally and externally. Effective listener and strong communication skills, both oral and written. Highly motivated self-starter who has a keen attention to detail, growth mindset, and ability to be comfortable in periods of unpredictability. DuPont is recruiting for an R&D Senior Analytical Lab Technologist to join our team at the DuPont Water Solutions (DWS) FilmTec™ site in Edina, MN. We are looking for candidates who are passionate about delivering innovative, sustainable solutions that meet our customers’ needs for a better, healthier, and safer life. DWS is a global leader in reverse osmosis (RO) and nanofiltration (NF) technologies, and the FilmTec™ innovation team develops membrane and module technologies that address critical water purification and separation challenges.

The Senior Analytical Lab Technologist will join our RO/NF analytical group as part of the broader R&D organization. This role combines hands-on analytical testing, technical problem solving, and method development to help teams understand material and product performance, resolve manufacturing and customer challenges, and advance next-generation membrane technologies. The R&D team works closely with Sales, Technical Services, Marketing, Manufacturing Technology, and Operations to translate end-user needs into technology concepts and ultimately commercial products.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform and oversee analytical testing using techniques such as ICP-OES, ICP-MS, IC, GC-MS, HPLC/UHPLC, and other relevant analytical methods.
• Select appropriate analytical techniques and sample preparation approaches to address complex technical questions and business needs.
• Interpret analytical data, draw scientifically sound conclusions, and provide actionable recommendations to project teams and stakeholders.
• Investigate manufacturing, product, and customer-related technical issues through data-driven root cause analysis and technical problem solving.
• Develop, validate, and implement new analytical methods and capabilities to support evolving technology and business needs.
• Maintain, calibrate, troubleshoot, and optimize analytical instrumentation to ensure reliable operation and high-quality data.
• Establish and uphold analytical quality standards, ensure data integrity, and assess the suitability of analytical results for technical decision-making.
• Partner with DuPont centralized research laboratories to access advanced characterization capabilities and coordinate specialized testing.
• Collaborate with technicians, scientists, engineers, manufacturing personnel, and technical experts to design experiments, answer technical questions, and solve challenging problems.
• Communicate analytical findings through technical reports, presentations, and discussions with stakeholders across functions.
• Continuously improve laboratory processes, testing efficiency, analytical workflows, and technical capabilities.
• Support safe laboratory operations and stewardship of facilities, equipment, and work practices.
• Contribute to a culture of scientific curiosity and innovation by applying analytical chemistry expertise to novel materials, emerging technologies, and unique technical challenges.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline. Relevant industry experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
• Foundational knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, laboratory practices, and chemical sample preparation.
• Experience operating, maintaining, and/or troubleshooting analytical laboratory instrumentation.
• Ability to interpret complex analytical data, assess data quality, and communicate technically sound conclusions.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document methods, results, and recommendations.
• Good manual dexterity and fine motor skills to safely prepare samples, operate laboratory equipment, and perform detailed laboratory procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior industrial and/or R&D laboratory experience.
• Hands-on experience with one or more of the following analytical techniques: ICP-OES, ICP-MS, IC, GC-MS, HPLC/UHPLC, FTIR, XRF, SEM, TOC analysis, or NMR.
• Proficiency in statistical analysis, experimental design, and data visualization tools.
